tokenization: Original full bag encoded once; slice token IDs without retokenizing
context: Repeat original actor/article prefix and complete subevent suffix in every window
body_ownership: Each original body token belongs to its earliest window; later overlap is context only
aggregation: Pool owned body tokens and each complete event per window; weight all scope vectors by owned_body_tokens / original_body_tokens; apply shared head once
positions: Reset positions to zero in each window
supervision: After aggregation only: one article target and one target per original actor-event; no window loss
short_bags: One window with identical original token IDs and scopes
context_overflow: Fail explicitly if repeated context leaves no body capacity or overlap is not smaller than capacity
P: Reuse J final bag logits; multiply sigmoid(article) by sigmoid(event) after aggregation
selection_basis: Input lengths and architectural limit only; no evaluation labels or model scores
